newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Great Wall Computer seeks HK listing - paper.
newsitem.headline: China Great Wall Computer seeks HK listing - paper.

text.p: China Great Wall Computer Group Corp has applied to the China Securities Regulatory Commission to list its computer subsidiary in Hong Kong, the Hong Kong Economic Times said on Monday.

China Great Wall plans to set up a new subsidiary Great Wall Technology Co Ltd which will hold the group's computer manufacturing and software development businessess following a group reorganisation, the newspaper said.
The group produced 5.0 billion yuan worth of personal computers in the past 10 years, the paper said but gave no further details.
